user.title: Connect a calendar account
user.description: Connect a CalDAV account (e.g. iCloud) with its URL and password, or sign in to Google Calendar with your own Google OAuth client.

caldav.title: Connect a CalDAV account
caldav.description: e.g. iCloud. Use an app-specific password if your provider requires one.

caldav_calendar.title: Choose calendars
caldav_calendar.description: Pick one or more calendars to expose as targets for the create_event service. Each becomes its own device. You can add more later from the account's device page.

data_description.calendar_url: Every calendar you select here becomes a separate device you can target with the create_event service.
data_description.default_reminder_minutes: Used when a create_event call doesn't specify its own reminder. Only takes effect if the method below isn't 'None'.
data_description.default_reminder_method: How the reminder shows up inside the calendar app itself (iOS/Google), not a Home Assistant notification. Choose 'None' if you never want a reminder unless a service call explicitly asks for one.
data_description.default_target: Lets a create_event call omit the target device entirely -- it will use this calendar instead. Only one calendar should be marked as default.
data_description.backfill_external_events: Off by default. When on, the periodic poll also adds the default reminder above to events it finds that weren't created through Home Assistant – e.g. added directly in the Google or iOS Calendar app, or an invitation you accepted. Leave off if you don't want Calendar Bridge touching events it didn't create itself.
data_description.notify_enabled: Schedules an independent Home Assistant notification for every event detected on this calendar, however it was created -- on top of, or instead of, the reminder above.
data_description.notify_target: A notify entity (e.g. your phone) to send the notification to. Required for the notification to actually fire.
data_description.notify_minutes_before: How many minutes before the event start the Home Assistant notification is sent.
data_description.notify_message_template: Supports the placeholders summary and start, each written in curly braces. Leave blank for the default message (Reminder: summary).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your CalDAV password
reauth_confirm.description: Calendar Bridge could no longer sign in to this CalDAV account. Enter the current password to reconnect.

stale_calendar.title: Calendar no longer found: {name}
stale_calendar.description: Calendar Bridge can no longer find "{name}" among this account's calendars -- it looks like it was deleted or unshared. Reminders and polling for it will keep failing until you remove this calendar (Settings → Devices & Services → Calendar Bridge → the "{name}" device → Delete device).

device_not_found.message: Device {device_id} is not a Calendar Bridge calendar.

no_target.message: No target calendar was given and no default target is configured. Pass a device or mark a calendar as the default target.

calendar_not_found.message: The calendar for device {device_id} could no longer be found on the server. It may have been renamed or deleted.

event_not_found.message: No event with uid {uid} could be found on that calendar. It may have already been deleted.

calendar_unavailable.message: The calendar for device {device_id} could not be reached right now. Please try again.

all_day_change_needs_start_and_end.message: Changing all_day also requires start and end, so the new event bounds are unambiguous.

occurrence_with_rrule_not_supported.message: A single occurrence cannot have its own rrule -- pass occurrence to change one instance, or rrule to change the whole series, not both.

no_notify_target.message: No notification target configured for this calendar.

calendar_not_loaded.message: The calendar for device {device_id} is not currently loaded (its account may be reloading or have a setup error).

end_before_start.message: The event's end must be after its start.

invalid_rrule.message: The rrule is not a valid RFC 5545 recurrence rule.

create_event.name: Create event
create_event.description: Creates a calendar event with a real reminder/alarm and, optionally, a recurrence rule.

device_id.name: Calendars
device_id.description: Which Calendar Bridge calendar(s) to create the event on. Defaults to the configured default target if omitted.

all_day.name: All day
all_day.description: Whether this is an all-day event.

reminder_minutes.name: Reminder minutes
reminder_minutes.description: Minutes before the event to show a single popup reminder. Ignored if 'reminders' is set.

reminder_time.name: Reminder time
reminder_time.description: For all-day events only: the time of day the reminder should fire (default 9:00 AM). Ignored for timed events.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.description: Up to 5 reminders. Each entry needs a method (popup or email) and minutes_before, and may optionally set reminder_time (all-day events only).

notify.name: Notification reminder
notify.description: Also send a Home Assistant notification before the event, independent of the calendar's own reminder. Needs a notify target and minutes_before; message is optional and supports {summary}/{start} placeholders (default: 'Reminder: {summary}').

delete_event.name: Delete event
delete_event.description: Deletes an event, identified by its uid, from a calendar.

device_id.name: Calendar
device_id.description: Which Calendar Bridge calendar the event is on. Defaults to the configured default target if omitted.

uid.name: Event UID
uid.description: The event's uid. create_event's response has a 'created' object mapping each targeted device_id to its own uid -- look up this device's uid there.

occurrence.name: Occurrence
occurrence.description: For a recurring event: the original start date/time of the single occurrence to delete. Leave empty to delete the whole series.

update_event.name: Update event
update_event.description: Changes one or more fields of an existing event, identified by its uid. Fields left out are unchanged.

device_id.name: Calendar
device_id.description: Which Calendar Bridge calendar the event is on. Defaults to the configured default target if omitted.

uid.name: Event UID
uid.description: The event's uid. create_event's response has a 'created' object mapping each targeted device_id to its own uid -- look up this device's uid there.

occurrence.name: Occurrence
occurrence.description: For a recurring event: the original start date/time of the single occurrence to change. Leave empty to change the whole series.

summary.name: Summary
summary.description: New event title. Left unchanged if omitted.

start.name: Start
start.description: New start date/time. Left unchanged if omitted.

end.name: End
end.description: New end date/time. Left unchanged if omitted.

all_day.name: All day
all_day.description: Change whether this is an all-day event. Left unchanged if omitted.

description.name: Description
description.description: New event description/notes. Left unchanged if omitted.

location.name: Location
location.description: New event location. Left unchanged if omitted.

reminder_minutes.name: Reminder minutes
reminder_minutes.description: Replaces every existing reminder with a single popup reminder this many minutes before the event. Ignored if 'reminders' is set. Left unchanged if omitted.

reminder_time.name: Reminder time
reminder_time.description: For all-day events only: the time of day the reminder should fire (default 9:00 AM). Ignored for timed events.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.description: Replaces every existing reminder with up to 5 new ones. Pass an empty list to remove all reminders. Left unchanged if omitted.

rrule.name: Recurrence rule
rrule.description: New RFC 5545 RRULE, e.g. 'FREQ=YEARLY'. Pass an empty string to remove recurrence. Left unchanged if omitted.

application_credentials.description:
Calendar Bridge signs in to Google with your own OAuth client.

1. Open the [OAuth consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}) and configure it.
2. Enable the Google Calendar API for the project.
3. Under [Credentials]({oauth_creds_url}) create an OAuth client ID. The type **TV and Limited Input devices** shows a short code to enter at google.com/device; the type **Web application** also works if you add `{redirect_url}` as authorized redirect URI.
4. Enter the Client ID and Client Secret here.

See [the setup guide]({more_info_url}) for details.
